ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

the alley next west of and parallel to South Spaulding Avenue; a line 25 feet north of and
parallel to West 16" Street; South Spaulding Avenue; and West 16" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its a\t and publication.
